**Synopsis:**
Bank of America posted a strong Q2 2026 beat, with net income of $9.1B ($1.21/share vs. $1.13 est.). Record trading revenue of $7.1B (+33% YoY) and a 70% surge in equities were the key drivers, fueled by Iran-related market volatility. Investment banking fees jumped 50% to $2.1B on record global M&A and a rebound in IPO activity (notably SpaceX's $2T debut). NII rose 9% to $16B. BofA raised its full-year NII outlook to the upper end of the +6–8% range. Consumer resilience and AI-driven capex are cited as macro tailwinds, while inflation and tight monetary policy remain flagged risks.
